title: World English Bible — Apocrypha/Deuterocanon (1 Esdras 5)

verification_log.method: 5:1–6: the heads of families go up under Darius, with an escort of one thousand cavalry; Zorobabel "spoke wise words before Darius … in the second year of his reign, in the month Nisan"; 5:7–40: the list (with variant readings in the notes); 5:41: "from twelve years old and upward … forty two thousand three hundred sixty"; 5:45: one thousand minas of gold, five thousand of silver; 5:47–55: altar in the seventh month; cedar to Joppa "according to the commandment … by Cyrus"; 5:56–57: foundation "on the new moon of the second month, in the second year after they had come"

access_notes: Greek parallel to Ezra 2–3; quoted only briefly.
